Growovo is now presented inside the unified OVO website, not as a separately styled homepage.

- English home: https://roy-tong.github.io/ovo/en.html
- Real cases: https://roy-tong.github.io/ovo/cases.html

- Get started: https://roy-tong.github.io/ovo/start.html
- Growovo repository and full agent entry: https://github.com/roy-tong/Growovo (repo-root llms.txt)
- Current capabilities: https://github.com/roy-tong/Growovo/blob/main/docs/feature-status.md
- Platform matrix: https://github.com/roy-tong/Growovo/blob/main/docs/platform-automation-matrix.md

Deep product guides and examples remain at their existing Growovo URLs, including /examples/controlled-run.html, /examples/controlled-run.en.html, /guides/launch-autopsy.html and /guides/launch-autopsy.en.html.
